name: Bearable
one_liner: Mood and symptom tracker that links how you feel to sleep, medication, activity and other factors so you can spot patterns.
best_for: People managing several conditions or medications who want to see what affects their mood and symptoms
People who want reports to share with a doctor or therapist
People who want a tracker that says it never sells data
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for therapy, coaching or a treatment program
People who find daily tracking stressful
short_description: Bearable tracks mood, symptoms, medication, sleep and habits, and shows which factors line up with your better and worse days.
long_description: Bearable is a self-tracking app from Bearable Ltd. You log mood, symptoms, medication, sleep, activity and anything else you choose, and the app shows correlations between them over time, which you can export or share with a clinician. It can pull data from Apple Health and Google Fit. Most features are free; an optional subscription ($6.99/month or $34.99/year, often discounted) adds more insight tools, and a sponsorship scheme offers premium to people who can't pay. Bearable says it does not and will never sell personal data, and you can delete your data in the app. It is a tracking tool, not a treatment, and we found no published study of it.
patient_summary: Bearable lets you log your mood, symptoms, medication and sleep and see what tends to go with your better and worse days. Most of it is free; premium is $6.99 a month or $34.99 a year. You can share reports with your doctor and delete your data in the app.

pricing.notes: Most tracking is free. Annual plan is often discounted (to $18.99, per Bearable). 7-day free trial. Bearable Heroes sponsorship gives premium to people who can't afford it.

privacy.notes: Says it does not and will never sell personal data and shares only with integrations you turn on; data can be deleted in the app or by email. Mozilla flagged a Facebook tracker in 2023.

faqs.a: Free; Premium about $34.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Bearable before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Bearable replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Bearable is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Bearable is available on iPhone and Android.
Mood, symptom and medication tracking; Correlation insights; Apple Health and Fitbit sync; Shareable reports and data export.

primary_uses: Spotting links between sleep, habits and mood
